meta.prompt: Using Denodo view admin.pg_vessel_positions_select, for IMO 9293155 (WONDER VEGA), retrieve one row per UTC calendar date with AIS records during December 2025 only. Include vesselname, imonumber, ais_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count, MIN(timestamp_date) AS first_ts_on_date, MAX(timestamp_date) AS last_ts_on_date. Group by vesselname, imonumber, ais_date. Sort by ais_date ascending. Return all rows.
